name: Tro Robinson
short_bio: Tro Robinson makes cut-paper paintings built from color, shape and movement, drawing on music and the Pacific coast.

sources.label: Tacoma Arts Month: Tacoma Studio Tour 2026 artist map

biography: Tro Robinson makes what he calls paper paintings: cut-paper works that began in sculpture and painting and grew into a single practice. He traces the approach to Matisse's idea of carving into color.
Music and movement run through the work, which he describes as a visual feeling for the rhythms of the coast and for the place where land, sea and sky meet.
